items.title: ADP: Private sector hiring fell short of expectations last month

items.title: Private sector added 44,000 jobs in July, below expectations, ADP says
items.summary: The figure reported on Wednesday is below economists’ estimates of an increase of 70,000 jobs. The prior month's reading was revised lower to 95,000.
